home.title: Server panel for Debian: simple, native, bilingual
home.lead: OWPanel sets up websites with HTTPS and HTTP/3, databases, backups and notifications natively on your own Debian server. No configuration files, in English and German.
home.status_text: The first public version, tested on servers in the Hetzner Cloud. Things may still change until version 1.0.
home.features_lead: Only the features you really need to run websites, done thoroughly and secure by default.

features.title: Websites with HTTP/3
features.text: Each website gets its own Linux user, PHP-FPM with PHP 8.5 or 8.6 and a certificate from Let's Encrypt. HTTP/3 over QUIC is always on, with HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 as fallback.

features.title: Databases in the panel
features.text: Create MariaDB databases, browse tables and content, run SQL, export and import, without phpMyAdmin.

features.title: Secure by default
features.text: nftables firewall with automatic rollback and blocklists, fail2ban, separate users per website, two-factor sign-in and an audit log.

features.title: Backups and snapshots
features.text: Backups with restic to a Hetzner Storage Box, daily or hourly, and Hetzner snapshots of the whole server with retention rules.

features.title: Recovery
features.text: Restore a whole website or single folders and databases, set up the panel again after a total loss and rebuild missing websites automatically.

features.title: Notifications
features.text: Messages by e-mail and push to phone and desktop: failed backups, servers down, full disks, expiring certificates. With quiet hours.

features.title: SFTP, cron jobs and logs
features.text: SFTP access per website with password or key, cron jobs without crontab and all important logs right in the panel.

features.title: Customers and packages
features.text: Assign websites to customers, packages with limits for websites, databases, cron jobs and backups. In their own customer area customers manage their websites themselves, with Pocket ID if you like. Billing and customer records stay in your own system; an API is planned.

features.title: One server or many
features.text: You start with one server. More servers join later without reinstalling and without migration: the panel takes every request as the gateway and passes it on to the server of the website.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Take a fresh Debian 13 server, run the start script, enter domain, time zone and the first administrator. The installer does the rest.

steps.title: Create a website
steps.text: Enter the domain, done. The panel sets up the Linux user, NGINX, PHP-FPM and the certificate with HTTP/3 by itself.

steps.title: Let it back up
steps.text: Set up the backup target and snapshots once. From then on the server backs up by itself and lets you know when something goes wrong.

roadmap.title: Where the project stands
roadmap.lead: OWPanel is developed step by step and tested on real servers. Each milestone ends with an acceptance test.

items.title: Server core
items.text: Scripts for NGINX with HTTP/3, PHP-FPM, MariaDB, firewall and websites

items.title: Panel foundation
items.text: Sign-in with two-factor, servers, tasks with live log, audit log

items.title: Usable standalone
items.text: Websites, databases, customers, SFTP, cron jobs, logs, firewall, updates

items.title: Backups and notifications
items.text: restic, Hetzner snapshots, recovery, e-mail and push

items.title: Pocket ID
items.text: Sign-in with a passkey through your own Pocket ID instance, for administrators and customers

items.title: DNS through the Hetzner API
items.text: Check, create and correct the records of each website and remove them on deletion

items.title: Customer area
items.text: Packages, customer access, websites, databases, cron jobs, backups, storage and suspension

items.title: Public release
items.text: SSH hardening, security review, blocklists, signed releases, version 0.1

items.title: Updates from the panel
items.text: Update the panel with one click or at night, server scripts follow by themselves, every release with a checked signature, version 0.2

items.title: Multi-server
items.text: More servers behind the panel as the gateway (since 0.5), next their backups, choosing the server on creation, moving websites with their backups

items.title: Docker apps
items.text: Your own services such as Pocket ID as a Compose project on a server, reachable through the panel, for administrators only

items.title: API
items.text: Connect your own homepage: customers, packages, status and a note about unpaid invoices

rows: NGINX with HTTP/3, HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1, PHP-FPM with PHP 8.5 and 8.6
restic, Hetzner Storage Box, Hetzner snapshots
Tabler and Inter, all served locally

open.title: Developed in the open, free to use
open.text: OWPanel is free software under the AGPL-3.0-or-later. It loads nothing from other servers, collects no data and runs entirely on your own server.
